name: Themes
author: Misty
overview: Themes is Misty's built-in theme builder. It previews Misty Dark, Misty Light, Graphite, Aurora, and Copper, then lets users fine-tune and persist the app's core color tokens without editing config files.
capabilities: Preview and apply Misty Dark, Misty Light, Graphite, Aurora, or Copper
Edit named theme tokens such as accent, border, text, and background colors
Persist theme changes across app restarts
permissions: Write access to Misty appearance settings
getting_started: Open Themes from Settings or the plugin launcher.
Choose Misty Dark, Misty Light, Graphite, Aurora, or Copper to preview a preset.
Adjust token hex values and press Apply Edits to save your custom palette.
changelog: v0.2.0 - Added non-destructive preview, apply and revert flows, persistent custom tokens, accessible color controls, and Misty-native presets.
v0.1.0 - Added the first theme builder.
